title: Fix device token malformed-body 500s leaking SQL
author: greatdaysl

gist.summary: Device authorization endpoints handle malformed request bodies without server errors. /api/device/token and /api/device/deny now use the shared form-or-JSON parser: missing or non-string codes return HTTP 400, and /token accepts form-encoded device codes. The parser also treats JSON null, arrays and primitives as empty objects. A JSON null body still works at /api/device/code, while /api/oauth/token returns HTTP 400 with unsupported_grant_type.
